page_title: GEN 0-2 CRE | Genoa v Cremonese 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Rosario Abisso has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) out-muscles his marker and gets the ball from the corner kick. He produces a shot, but it goes way wide of the left post. High, wide and not pretty at all.
90+4' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Genoa.
90+3' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar.
90+3' The ball is out of play. Genoa win a corner kick.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' A corner kick by Genoa is thwarted by the well prepared Emil Audero (Cremonese).
89' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
88' Here is a change. Warren Bondo is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Jeremy Sarmiento (Cremonese).
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Francesco Folino (Cremonese) coming on for Matteo Bianchetti.

83' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Morten Frendrup (Genoa) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Emil Audero pulls off a comfortable save.
79' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) for a tough tackle.
77' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Romano Floriani and he is replaced by Mikayil Faye (Cremonese).
73' Substitution. Federico Bonazzoli did his best and is replaced by Franco Vazquez (Cremonese).
72' Rosario Abisso shows the yellow card to Nicola Leali (Genoa) for a heavy challenge.
70' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cremonese.
68' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aaron Martin leaves the pitch and Morten Frendrup (Genoa) comes on.
63' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Valentin Carboni is replaced by Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa).
62' It's a yellow card for Vitinha (Genoa).
61' The goal by Genoa won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
58' Wait! Referee Rosario Abisso immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
57' A goal, which was scored by Vitinha (Genoa), was disallowed due to offside.
55' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
53' Patrick Vieira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) replacing Jeff Ekhator.
53' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Vitinha (Genoa) is coming onto the pitch as Maxwel Cornet cannot continue after picking up an injury.
49' 0 - 2 Goal! Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper inside the right post. 0:2.
49' Cremonese have a corner.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' Rosario Abisso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
45+4' Genoa force a corner. They send men into the box.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
43' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
42' Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Genoa.
41' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) poorly executes the free kick and the ball only hits the wall.
37' Valentin Carboni (Genoa) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
37' Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) is adjudged offside.
36' Valentin Carboni (Genoa) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
34' Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) commits a foul and Rosario Abisso immediately signals a free kick.
32' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.
30' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) has time and space to shoot after latching onto a pass, but his screamer of a shot flies just wide of the left post.
26' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Genoa.
9' Referee Rosario Abisso signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Cremonese players have a reason to celebrate!
6' Celebrations by Cremonese are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
3' 0 - 1 GOAL! Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) gets on the scoresheet after finding some space in the box to acrobatically score from the corner kick. 0:1.
3' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) prepares to take a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Genoa will kick-off.
Rosario Abisso will officiate today.
